MAR.note: Document does not mention public e-procurement.
Only says the central bank encourages bank cards and cheques; no mandate, licensing, switch or PAPSS statement.
Nothing on consumer rules or complaints for digital finance.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Justice Minister Abdellatif Ouahbi told a parliamentary committee that a national enforcement platform, letting enforcement files be processed nationally and not only in Casablanca, has entered implementation and is being extended to all courts.

MAR.note: No statement on mobile money, wallets or a national switch.
Court-fee e-payment is only proposed to banks, who mostly declined; no statement of electronic payment in service or cash only.
